facts.statement: The genus Pedopenna was described by Xu and Zhang in 2005.
facts.quote: Xu & Zhang, 2005

facts.statement: Pedopenna is possibly older than Archaeopteryx, although the exact age of the Daohugou Beds where it was found is debated.
facts.quote: It is possibly older than Archaeopteryx, though the age of the Daohugou Beds where it was found is debated.

facts.statement: Most studies suggest the Daohugou Beds, where Pedopenna was found, date from between 168 million and 152 million years ago.
facts.quote: A majority of studies suggest that the beds probably date from between the late Middle Jurassic (168 million years ago) and early Late Jurassic Period (164-152 million years ago).

facts.statement: Recent studies have recovered Pedopenna as a scansoriopterygid.
facts.quote: More recently, it has been recovered as a scansoriopterygid.

facts.statement: The longest feathers on Pedopenna's foot were about 55 mm (2 in) long, slightly shorter than the metatarsus.
facts.quote: The longest feathers were slightly shorter than the metatarsus, at about 55 mm (2 in) long.

facts.statement: Xu and Zhang suggested in 2005 that Pedopenna's foot feathers could be ornamental or vestigial.
facts.quote: Xu and Zhang, in their 2005 description of Pedopenna, suggested that the feathers could be ornamental, or even vestigial.

facts.statement: Pedopenna lived during the Middle Jurassic, approximately 163 million years ago in the Callovian stage, in what is now Asia.
facts.quote: que vivió a mediados del período Jurásico, hace aproximadamente hace 163 millones de años, en el Calloviense, en lo que hoy es Asia.

facts.statement: Pedopenna was probably a carnivore that hunted insects, small reptiles, and mammals.
facts.quote: Pedopenna era probablemente carnívoro, cazador de insectos y pequeños reptiles y mamíferos.

facts.statement: Pedopenna had an enlarged claw on the second toe that was slightly shortened and not as highly developed as the sickle-shaped claws of its relatives.
facts.quote: Pedopenna tenía una garra agrandada y acortada levemente en el segundo dedo del pie, no era tan altamente desarrollada como para haber estado curvada fuertemente, como la hoz de sus parientes.

facts.statement: Xu and Zhang postulated that Asia is the cradle of the origin of birds based on the presence of this basal avian lineage member.
facts.quote: postularon que Asia es la cuna del origen de las aves.

facts.statement: Pedopenna shows evidence of shorter feathers covering the long foot feathers, suggesting the presence of coverts as seen in modern birds.
facts.quote: Pedopenna también demuestra la evidencia de plumas más cortas que cubren las plumas largas del pie, lo que hace pensar en la presencia de un abrigo de plumas según lo visto en pájaros modernos.

facts.statement: Pedopenna fossils were found in the Daohugou Bed of the Tiaojishan Formation in Hebei and Liaoning, China.
facts.quote: Pedopenna fue hallado en el Lecho Daohugou, parte de la formación Tiaojishan, en Hebei y Liaoning, República Popular China.

facts.statement: The name Pedopenna refers to the long pennaceous feathers on its metatarsus.
facts.quote: El nombre Pedopenna hace referencia alas largas plumas penaceas en su metatarso

facts.statement: Recent radiometric dating places Pedopenna in the middle Jurassic Callovian, approximately 168 million years ago.
facts.quote: las últimas dataciones radiométricas lo colocan a mediados del Jurásico durante el Calloviano, hace 168 millones de años.

facts.statement: The time range for Pedopenna is estimated between 165.3 and 161.5 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Callovian to Callovian (165.3 to 161.5 million years ago)

facts.statement: Pedopenna is classified within Paraves, the group of maniraptoran dinosaurs that includes birds and their closest relatives.
facts.quote: Pedopenna es clasificado dentro de Paraves, el grupo de dinosaurios manirraptores que incluyen a las Aves y sus parientes más cercanos.

facts.statement: More recently, Pedopenna has been recovered as a scansoriopterygid.
facts.quote: Más recientemente, se ha recuperado como escansoriopterígido.

facts.statement: The parent group for Pedopenna is Paraves.
facts.quote: Parent group: Paraves

facts.statement: Pedopenna is classified under the class Reptilia.
facts.quote: Class: Reptilia

facts.statement: The specific epithet P. daohugouensis refers to the Daohugou locality where the holotype was found.
facts.quote: el epíteto específico P. daohugouensis hace referencia a la localidad de Daohugou, lugar donde el holotipo fuera encontrado.

facts.statement: It is debated whether Pedopenna is as old as Archaeopteryx, depending on the age of the Daohugou Bed.
facts.quote: Es posiblemente tan antigua como Archaeopteryx, dependiendo de la edad del Lecho Daohugou que se encuentra en debate
